name.zh: 环境变量 / hosts 编辑（GDI）

description.zh: 可视化编辑用户环境变量与 hosts 条目：交互窗口支持多选批量、分隔项编辑与中英文界面；改写前自动备份，系统级目标未提权时明确降级
description.en: Visual editor for user env vars and hosts: multi-select batch commands, split-item editing and a zh/en UI; auto-backup before writes; honest degradation for admin-only targets

notes.zh:
# GDI 0.7.5

同一个插件 ID；安装另一版会替换当前版，设置和备份保留，草稿按版本类型隔离。
Both editions share one plugin ID. Installing the other replaces this edition. Settings/backups are retained; drafts are stored separately per backend.

下载 / Downloads: [GDI](https://github.com/ra9fael/winshun-envhosts/releases/latest) · [QML](https://github.com/ra9fael/winshun-envhosts/tree/qml#安装)

插件库目前不区分后端；QML 请从 QML 发布页更新。
The plugin library does not track backends; update QML from its release page.

### Added

- Maintained GDI/QML branches and mutually exclusive packages sharing one plugin ID.
- Backend/version verification before packaging, separate release tags and bilingual download choices.

### Fixed

- Isolate GDI drafts, route legacy drafts by format and archive original bytes without overwriting newer drafts.
- Refuse incompatible QML multi-string/raw backups and preserve user/system scope boundaries when restoring shared snapshots.
